verified_properties: Both source engine and wrapper explicitly allow integer weights 1..16.
No source or executable change is required for weight16.
All strict energy improvements are saved; engine-result stores the best score.
Both FN and FP zero trigger full2048 scalar checking and independent raw validator.
limitations: Weight16 favors but does not enforce all-positive sources. Any all-positive source with at most15FP has lower score than every source with at least1FN because the live tie-break is at most0.42.
All-positive16FP is not strictly preferred over1FN0FP; 17..24FP can lose.
Only strict overall energy improvements are saved; an all-positive circuit need not be retained if a prior state has lower energy.
Higher weight does not prove better runtime or success; no effectiveness claim.
Never treat all-positive sources or local UNSAT as posted witnesses/refutations.

candidate_intake.criteria: 21 augmented gates; strict acyclic structure; all16 edge rows and all1923 target-positive inputs accepted; 1..15 false-positive maximal-independent rows by default.
repair_modes: Free-output exact-target distanceK2/K3, all gate descriptions editable with cardinality bound.
Free-output exact-target local3/5-hole repairs, ranked by forced-FALSE error influence.

resource_note: Coordinator schedules only; do not start while its chain certificate occupies spare CPUs.
